units.source_zh: 此时此刻，若有人问，究竟谁才是真正为丰臣氏着想之人，三成定会当场羞得无地自容。

paragraphs.source_zh: 三成的话无非一时意气，是语无伦次的呼号、是感情的宣泄；而利家的流泪，却是实实在在。此时此刻，若有人问，究竟谁才是真正为丰臣氏着想之人，三成定会当场羞得无地自容。

paragraphs.source_en: Realizing this, Mitsunari hastily prostrated himself. “Mitsunari truly spoke without restraint and went much too far. I too...shall abide by your judgment. Please forgive me.”

paragraphs.source_zh: 意识到这些，三成慌忙伏在地上，“三成的确口不择言，太过分了。三成也……服从大人的裁断。请大人见谅。”

paragraphs.source_en: Mitsunari wilted like an eggplant struck by frost. No matter how Toshiie might mock him now, he would no longer feel such intense resentment.

paragraphs.source_en: “Jibu was born with talents and gifts that others can only envy. It would be best for him to remain in my house for a while. Toshimasa, do you hear me?”

paragraphs.source_en: “As you command!”

units.source_zh: “遵命！”

paragraphs.source_en: “Among the commanders, many have already had their wits consumed by rage. If some misfortune were to befall Jibu, it would bring suffering to the world. Everything must be considered for the sake of the Toyotomi clan, and every action must place the Toyotomi clan at its center. That is true benevolence.”
